As Kuroneko was saying that, she looked restless 
and fidgeted with her hands.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Are you really okay? We can rest for a bit longer if 
you'd like...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I'm fine, didn't I say so earlier?

Seems like no matter how many times I ask, she 
won't be honest...

And so we left the cafe. But, since she's definitely 
acting strange, I'd better keep an eye on her.
